### New

- **Song progress line.** A new switch under **Display → Top bar** draws a thin line under the words that fills up as the song plays. It hides itself when your music player doesn't say how long the song is.

- **Arrival.** A new setting under **Lyrics → Lines** for the World layout picks how each floating word shows up: **Pop** (as before), **Drop** (falls in from above and bounces as it lands), **Zoom** (grows out of nothing) or **Fade** (slowly fades in). The old **Animation** row is hidden in World, since it only ever changed the other layouts.
- **Neon shades.** A new hat under **Look → Hat**: dark sunglasses with rims, a bridge and hinges that glow in your lyrics colour, and a soft streak of light across the lenses. Like the other hats, it flares up with each new line when **Glow with the lyrics** is on.

### Fixed

- **Words stay with their line.** When the sky is crowded, a World word now looks for room only along its own row or the next one, so it no longer drops far below the rest of its line.
- **Words in front of trees.** A World word that would land behind a tree, hill or wall now comes closer and shows in front of it, so you can still read it.
- **Fuller rows.** A flowing World line now fits two or three words on each row, like a little staircase, instead of stacking one word per row. Rows also get wider when you turn up **Size** (but never wider than your screen, so big words don't run off the edge), and a new line no longer gets pushed sideways by words that are already fading out.
- **Softer fade.** Sung World words now fade smoothly into the sky instead of hanging on as dim grey smudges and then blinking out.
- **Lines stay on screen.** A flowing World line that slopes or bows upward now starts low enough that even its highest words, after they drift up while fading, stay well under the top of your screen. New words also no longer get shoved up the sky by older words that are fading out.
